ai-quota-monitor.name: AI Quota and Usage Monitoring
ai-quota-monitor.description: View quotas and credits for Gemini, Codex, CodeBuddy, OpenCode, Claude, Grok, GLM, and Kimi; display up to three selected tabs, and aggregate local Token usage, costs, and heatmaps.

auto-title.name: Automatic Session Naming
auto-title.description: After each conversation round, generate a session title using the local CLI or DeepSeek in the format "emoji + subject | objective"; supports codex / omp / pi / claude. Does not overwrite manually renamed sessions; can be paused or set to name only once.

background-ui.name: Background and UI Enhancements
background-ui.description: Optimized interface aesthetics including app background, 12 theme color schemes, curtains, timelines, tabs, focus glows, scrollbars, etc.; built-in Wallhaven / UPX8 online wallpaper galleries with search, pagination, previews, setting as background, and history management; images downloaded via local node sharding. Features derived from upstream plugins of Guardian-J (full sources listed in README).

balance-meter.name: Balance and Remaining Quota
balance-meter.description: Identifies vendors and billing methods based on the gateway actually used by the current engine: API checks balance, subscriptions check remaining quota; currently supports ChatGPT, Claude, OpenCode Go, Kimi, Zhipu, MiniMax, Grok subscription channels, clearly notifies when no available API exists; supports manual refresh and automatic refresh after each conversation round.

ccgui-svn.name: SVN Management Panel
ccgui-svn.description: Manages SVN changes, history, differences, and conflicts within the current workspace in the CC GUI.

ccgui.client-context-bridge.name: Cross-Client Context Bridging (CCB)
ccgui.client-context-bridge.description: Automatically maintains and resumes task contexts across different AI CLI clients, supporting independent start/stop per workspace.

ccgui.live2d-pets.name: Live2D Desktop Pet
ccgui.live2d-pets.description: Renders an interactive Live2D desktop pet on the interface, mirroring the AI status (thinking/waiting for approval/error/completed/idle) of the currently active session; supports petting head and legs, mouse following, drag-and-dock functionality, six character dialogue sets, and custom model animation mappings.

claude-ip-check.name: Claude IP Check
claude-ip-check.description: Views the egress IP, purity, geography, and risk signals for accessing Claude: triple egress IPs, trust score, security checks, DNS/WebRTC leaks, device information, and IP history. Ported from TokenTracker.

cli-install-audit.name: CLI Installation Detection
cli-install-audit.description: Individually probes CLI engines supported by the CC GUI, compares PATH entries with running process versions and SHA256 hashes, flags missing or forked versions.

composer-rainbow-border.name: Rainbow Marquee Border
composer-rainbow-border.description: Displays a rainbow marquee over the chat input box and session tab during conversations, showing a green breathing unread border upon completion of background sessions.

daily-sentence.name: Daily Quote
daily-sentence.description: Displays a daily quote on the left side of the status bar, supporting various animations, custom interfaces and field mappings, and automatic updates by day, hour, or minute.

dsh-skins-ccgui.name: DSH Skins and Wallpapers
dsh-skins-ccgui.description: Brings dsh-skins' three color schemes and eight built-in wallpapers to the CC GUI, supporting instant switching, reading masks, and image adaptation.

engine-hopper.name: Engine Relay
engine-hopper.description: Switches engines and models anytime within the same conversation: automatically organizes complete conversation context and intelligently layers handoffs, allowing new engines to seamlessly continue chats; supports relay chain backtracking and incremental continuation.

file-drag-upload.name: File Drag-and-Drop Upload
file-drag-upload.description: Drag files into the chat window, supporting previews, deletions, and reordering.

file-preview-panel.name: File Preview Panel
file-preview-panel.description: Browses the workspace file tree in the right panel, directly previewing Markdown (including Mermaid diagrams) and text files without opening additional main tabs. Supports only Windows.

font-tuner.name: Font Tuning
font-tuner.description: Customizes window interface fonts, dialogue content fonts, and code fonts, with configurable font size, line height, letter spacing, font smoothing, and text rendering modes.

git-workbench.name: Git Workbench
git-workbench.description: Recreates IntelliJ IDEA's Git tool windows: multi-repo recognition, local changes/commits, commit graphs, branches, merges/rebasing, stashing, tags, remotes, submodules, blame, console. Directly drives the local git CLI, compatible with any git version and hosting platform.

github-tasks.name: CCGUI · Git Task Management
github-tasks.description: Read-only multi-repo PR workflow board: daily additions, whether I've reviewed them, whether authors have fixed issues, whether I've checked fixes; board drag-and-drop only records local markers; sidebar worktree displays PR statuses.

local-memory.name: Long-Term Memory
local-memory.description: Local long-term memory (global preferences, project-specific memories, and agent-specific specifications), supporting dynamic natural language memorization, engine-isolated injection, and settings page management.

local-task-monitor.name: Local Task Monitoring
local-task-monitor.description: Monitors the CC GUI process tree and associated sidebar workspace listening services: PID, project, port, CPU, memory; workspace services can be stopped or restarted with secondary confirmation while the process tree remains read-only.

mermaid-markdown.name: Mermaid Charts
mermaid-markdown.description: Renders ```mermaid code blocks in responses into actual charts, with adjustable size and layout density, supporting both light and dark themes.

model-quota.name: Model Quota Capsules
model-quota.description: Displays the current session's model channel's 5-hour/weekly/monthly quota (used percentage, hover for remaining) as capsules in the input box status bar, supporting Zhipu GLM Coding Plan and OpenCode Go.

model-switcher.name: Model and Vendor Assistant
model-switcher.description: Includes CLI selection, vendor channel switching, independent channel management, global theme, session model display, canvas link navigation, and optional Claude Agent SDK prompt cleaning.

personal-task-board.name: Personal Task Dashboard
personal-task-board.description: Manages tasks locally, delegating them to CC GUI native sessions for execution and manual acceptance.

port-manager.name: Port Management
port-manager.description: Groups locally listened TCP ports by workspace, with collapsible groups, supporting one-click browser opening and port closing; automatically adapts to macOS / Linux / Windows, running purely locally without network access.

project-knowledge.name: Project Knowledge
project-knowledge.description: Mounts notes/to-dos/plans from the current project into the conversation context: three tabs on the right panel for adding, deleting, and editing; mounting is isolated per session, automatically injected to the model before sending, and removed afterward.

prompt-enhancer.name: Prompt Enhancement
prompt-enhancer.description: Uses dedicated text API prompt enhancement by default, compatible with OpenAI, Responses, Claude, Gemini; supports selectable engine modes and write-back after preview.

prompt-optimizer.name: Prompt Optimizer
prompt-optimizer.description: brings 41 official prompt templates from prompt-optimizer v2.13.0 into CC GUI: an ✨ popup next to the input box, four major categories—Basic/Context/Image/Variable—with 15 sub-patterns, supporting optimization, iteration, evaluation, variable extraction, and image prompts; results can be written back with one click.

react-doctor.name: React Doctor
react-doctor.description: Runs npx react-doctor@latest code health check with one click: score ring, error/warning stats, problem list grouped by file with fix suggestions, original output; results are persisted locally; if not perfect, "One-Click Fix" fills the issue list into the chat input box.

scheduled-tasks.name: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled-tasks.description: Triggers AI rounds on schedule in specified workspaces using a 5-field cron: each round creates a new visible session in the sidebar, with real-time streaming, takeover, and stop capabilities; supports skill binding, natural language task creation, run history, failure backoff, and automatic pausing. Does not execute when CC GUI is closed.

service-status.name: Service Status
service-status.description: Aggregates real-time incident statuses from official status pages of Claude / OpenAI / Cursor / GitHub / Gemini / Kimi / MiniMax / Zed on the central tab, refreshing automatically every minute.

session-engine-filter.name: Session Source Blocking
session-engine-filter.description: Blocks sidebar sessions by CLI engine: uncheck engines you don't want to see (Pi, Codex, Grok, Kimi...), and their session rows disappear from workspace lists; can be restored at any time, affecting only display and leaving session data untouched.

session-notes.name: Session Notes
session-notes.description: Puts local notes on any session: edit current session remarks on the right panel, quick access via right-click menu, unified list management; data stored only locally.

session-rainbow-border.name: Workspace Conversation Marquee
session-rainbow-border.description: Adds gradient rotation, flashing breath, blazing flames, and other light-effect borders to active conversation list items in the left sidebar workspace during runtime, supporting customizable panel switching and real-time previews.

slash-palette.name: Claude Slash Commands
slash-palette.description: Supports only Claude Code: tap "/ Commands" next to the input box to search and insert plugin and user commands/skills, eliminating the need to memorize command names.

smart-session-title.name: Smart Session Naming
smart-session-title.description: Automatically generates short titles prefixed with emojis for sessions after each round: direct-engine CLI smart naming (defaults to follow session engine, can pin engine/model, does not log to conversation records); falls back to local keyword rules upon failure; status bar shows progress and failure reasons, with debug logs and right-click rename option.

token-meter.name: Token Speedometer
token-meter.description: composer status line displays token output speed and cache hit rate in real time, supporting all 11 CLI engines.

translation.name: Light Translation
translation.description: Right-click translation of selected text, automatic translation in the status bar, and single translations alongside model replies. Supports Bing, Google, and custom AI.

usage-limits.name: Usage and Quotas
usage-limits.description: Status bar permanently displays today's tokens, estimated costs, and 5h/7d quota labels for Claude / Codex (with platform icons); tap to view trends, project/model details, and pace forecasts; data calculated locally by CC GUI from various CLI logs, never uploaded.

window-model-assistant.name: Window and Model Assistant
window-model-assistant.description: Only manages the position and size of the CC GUI main window (auto-recovery/save/recommended dimensions/WeChat sampling, leaving other windows untouched), while transparently displaying the host's public vendor model directory by engine and source; initial load stays offline, accessing vendor APIs only upon manual refresh, falling back to cached degraded mode with reason标注 upon failure.

wsl.name: WSL Manager
wsl.description: WSL Distribution Manager: local diagnostics and default settings, engine probe, remote host (password/key), WSL workspace registration, file panel within the distribution, and session lists and historical playback for Claude/Codex/OMP.
